conventions: Android string resources live in app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml

This file is a Jetpack Glance widget, not Compose UI — it has no access to androidx.compose.ui.res.stringResource. Use context.getString(...)/context.resources.getQuantityString(...) instead, where context is either the provideGlance(context, ...) parameter (captured by closure inside provideContent) or androidx.glance.LocalContext.current for composables that don't receive it directly.
